paragraphs: (A place name; Genesis 14:15.) Rabbi Shmuel bar Chova; Kohelet Rabbah 1:7–8.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The biblical place is Chova in Genesis14:15. Kohelet Rabbah1:7–8 is the separate locator for Shmuel bar Chova.

The whole named Miqra according to the Masorah Genesis 14:15 gives the place Chova, and the whole Torat Emet Kohelet Rabbah 1:7:8 paragraph fully names Rabbi Shmuel bar Chova. The source collective heading and separate 1:7–8 locator remain alongside that digital subdivision, without linking the biblical place to the patronym or asserting one father. The current note remains verbatim.
